job.job_description:
We are seeking a highly experienced AI Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in Generative AI, Azure cloud, and modern software engineering practices. The ideal candidate will lead the design and implementation of scalable AI solutions, leveraging LLMs, agentic AI systems, and cloud-native architectures.




This role requires a strong background in Java/Python development, combined with deep expertise in Azure, containerization, orchestration, and AI system observability.




Experience : 5 to 12 years

Location : Pune , Bangalore

Notice period : Immediate to 30 days




Key Responsibilities

Design and build GenAI / LLM-based solutions
Implement RAG, prompt engineering, and AI orchestration
Develop scalable architectures on Azure (AKS, cloud services)
Set up AI observability & performance optimization
Lead AI initiatives and mentor teams



Required Skills

Java / Python
Generative AI, LLMs
Azure (AKS, cloud architecture)
RAG, vector databases, prompt engineering
Docker, Kubernetes
GitHub Copilot (preferred)
